campaign.name: Beat the surface code at k=100, weight-8, unrestricted

direction.hypothesis: An unrestricted weight-8 code can beat the cell frontier entry 392-102-14 (k=102, d=14, n=392, kd^2/n=51.0) on kd^2/n; target kd^2/n > 51.0 (e.g. k>=95, d>=15, n<=1000).

bar.note: Cell frontier entry (upper bound); unrestricted weight-8 cell supports n up to 1000 at w<=8, d<=40.

direction.feasibility: Unrestricted weight-8 cell supports n up to 1000 at w<=8, d<=40.

novelty.claim: Extend the unrestricted weight-8 frontier beyond (k=102,d=14,n=392); not the first systematic k~100 probe in this cell.

direction.expected_value: An unrestricted weight-8 code on the cell frontier at kd^2/n > 51.0 would be a milestone result.
direction.what_a_negative_would_teach: Whether unrestricted weight-8 constructions can reach k~100, or whether the cell saturates earlier.
